# Pernod Ricard

> Daily AI-assisted intelligence on Pernod Ricard: strategy, luxury spirits, premiumisation, digital transformation and M&A.

Content is in English. Articles are collected nightly from public RSS feeds of pet food trade publications; summaries and the daily briefing are AI-generated, and each item links to its original source.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/pernod-ricard/): articles of the last 30 days with the daily briefing
- [Archive](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/pernod-ricard/archive/index.html): one page per month, all articles

## Machine-readable

- [Atom feed](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/pernod-ricard/feed.xml): 50 latest articles
- [JSON data](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/pernod-ricard/data.json): briefing and articles from the last 30 days
- [Sitemap](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/pernod-ricard/sitemap.xml)

## Categories

- 🤝 Strategy & M&A
- 🥃 Spirits & Brands
- 📈 Market
- 💡 Innovation & RTD

## Sources

- [Pernod Ricard Corporate & M&A (Google News)](https://www.pernod-ricard.com): Actualités corporate, résultats financiers, stratégie globale, nominations et M&A.
- [Pernod Ricard Premium Brands (Google News)](https://www.pernod-ricard.com/en/brands): Innovations produits, campagnes de marque, éditions limitées et lancements premium.
- [Just Drinks](https://www.just-drinks.com/): La référence internationale B2B sur l'industrie mondiale des boissons et spiritueux.
- [Spirits & RTD Innovation (Google News)](https://www.pernod-ricard.com): Cocktails prêts à boire (RTD), sans alcool, packaging et engagements RSE.
